trust_decision.summary: Whether an rfc822Name / URI (and directoryName) in a leaf lies inside a CA's permitted/excluded name-constraint subtrees, decided in PKIXNameConstraintValidator's isEmailConstrained / isURIConstrained / withinDNSubtree; rfc822Name and URI host compares were exact while dNSName strips an RFC 1034 trailing dot.

landing_point.why: Summary names rfc822Name and URI trailing dot; isEmailConstrained sits next to isDNSConstrained, which already shows the stripTrailingDot idiom (line 1197).

fix_sites.entry_point: checkPermitted/checkExcluded(GeneralName uniformResourceIdentifier); via CertPathValidator RFC3280CertPathUtilities.java:1213-1214 and PKIXCertPathReviewer
checkPermittedDN/checkExcludedDN(X500Name); via RFC3280CertPathUtilities.java:1158-1159 and PKIXCertPathReviewer (DN-prefix bypass bundled in the same commit, not in the advisory summary)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: core/src/main/jdk1.4/org/bouncycastle/asn1/x509/PKIXNameConstraintValidator.java:1007-1033 and :1740-1752 (jdk1.4 source variant, built by ant/jdk14.xml:234; not touched by the fix and also lacking the earlier dNSName trailing-dot fix at :1104 and the DN-prefix fix at :335)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The jdk1.4 tree is a legacy source variant used only by the ant JDK 1.4 build, not the gradle/main artefact, so a solver can argue it is unsupported and out of scope; the published fix itself left it alone.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Host-form constraint "bank.com" must still reject subdomain mail x@sub.bank.com and still accept user@bank.com; a bare "." is preserved by stripTrailingDot; the relaxed SGP.22 DN anywhere-match must keep working behind Properties.X509_SGP22_NAME_CONSTRAINTS. An over-broad fix (endsWith, stripping all dots, or routing hosts through withinDomain) breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: trailing dot on the leaf rfc822Name host (user@bank.com.)
trailing dot on the constraint side (mailbox, @domain and host forms)
mailbox-form constraint (local@host) vs @domain vs host vs .domain forms
URI host with trailing dot, incl. before :port or path (https://competitor.example./, host.:443)
URI exact-host constraint with trailing dot
DN with RDNs prepended before the permitted sequence (bundled second bug)

O7_producer.where: Constraint sets are built by intersectEmail/unionEmail/intersectURI/unionURI (core/src/main/java/org/bouncycastle/asn1/x509/PKIXNameConstraintValidator.java:1222-1357, :1574-1665, :1724-1815) with exact equalsIgnoreCase and no trailing-dot canonicalisation, but mismatches there drop or keep both entries (fail-closed), not a bypass.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a host-identity differential in extractHostFromURL (e.g. trailing dot surviving a userinfo/port split, or percent-encoded dot) so the canonicalised host differs from what the check compares
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: hand-rolled RFC 3986 authority parsing with several strip steps; a maintainer could order them so the dot strip happens before the port strip

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a wrapper that pre-normalises or re-implements email matching for the PKIXCertPathReviewer path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: prov and pkix already each carry a thin wrapper class around the core validator; a convenience fast-path there is plausible

O9_family: CWE-295 certificate validation: name-constraint canonicalisation differential (trailing root-label dot) on rfc822Name/URI hosts, plus DN prefix matching

O10_build.toolchain: Gradle (main build); ant scripts for legacy jdk1.x variants (ant/jdk14.xml)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Strip the trailing dot from the leaf email host only in the host-form branch, missing the mailbox/@domain/constraint side and the URI path.

out_of_scope_notes: prov/src/main/jdk1.1/org/bouncycastle/jce/provider/PKIXCertPathValidatorSpi.java:380-427 has an ancient independent email check using endsWith (suffix match, no label boundary); different weakness, not pursued.
The fix bundles an unrelated directoryName prefix bypass (fix.diff:13-34) not described in the advisory summary.
